keyPoints.en: Penang 1786 (Francis Light, Kedah wanted protection from Siam); Singapore 1819 (Raffles recognised Tengku Hussein); Melaka 1824 (London Treaty).
keyPoints.bm: Pulau Pinang 1786 (Francis Light, Kedah mahukan perlindungan daripada Siam); Singapura 1819 (Raffles mengiktiraf Tengku Hussein); Melaka 1824 (Perjanjian London).

keyPoints.en: London Treaty, 17 March 1824: Britain took Melaka and areas north of Singapore; the Dutch took Bencoolen and areas south.
keyPoints.bm: Perjanjian London, 17 Mac 1824: British mengambil Melaka dan kawasan utara Singapura; Belanda mengambil Bangkahulu dan kawasan selatan.

keyPoints.en: Effects: Johor-Riau split, Malay world divided without consulting rulers, basis of the Malaysia–Indonesia border.
keyPoints.bm: Kesan: Johor-Riau berpecah, Alam Melayu dibahagi tanpa berunding dengan raja, asas sempadan Malaysia–Indonesia.

keyPoints.en: Formed in 1826 (Penang, Melaka, Singapore) for easier, cheaper administration.
keyPoints.bm: Dibentuk pada 1826 (Pulau Pinang, Melaka, Singapura) untuk pentadbiran lebih mudah dan murah.

keyPoints.en: Governor heads the SS; a Resident Councillor runs each settlement. Capital: Penang, then Singapore from 1832.
keyPoints.bm: Gabenor mengetuai NNS; Residen Konsilor mentadbir setiap negeri. Pusat: Pulau Pinang, kemudian Singapura mulai 1832.

keyPoints.en: Ruled from India until 1867, then a Crown Colony under the Colonial Office in London.
keyPoints.bm: Ditadbir dari India hingga 1867, kemudian Tanah Jajahan Mahkota di bawah Pejabat Tanah Jajahan di London.
